        or not 0 <= coup[2] < etat["colonnes"]
    ):

    ligne = etat["lignes"] - 1 - coup[1]
    colonne = coup[2]
    if etat["grille"][ligne][colonne] is not None:
        raise ValueError("coup illegal")
